title: Remedy for non-compliance with directions issued

versions.Latest:
85. Remedy for non-compliance with directions issued.—

—   If the owner or the person 
having control as aforesaid fails or neglects to comply with any such requisition within 
the time required by or under the provisions of section 84, the Panchayat may, and, if in 
the opinion of the Secretary immediate action is necessary to protect the health or safety 
of any person, he shall at once, proceed to execute the work required by such notice, and 
all the expenses incurred thereon shall be paid by the owner, or person, having control 
over such source of water supply, and shall be recovered in the same manner as an 
amount claimed on account of any tax recoverable under this Act: 
Provided that in the case of any well or private stream or any private channel, tank or 
other source of water supply the water of which is used by the public or by any section of 
the   public   as   of   right,   the   expenses   incurred   by   such   owner   or   the   person 
having control may, if the Panchayat so directs, be paid from the Panchayat fund.
